claim.quote: We derived new upper limits on couplings of electrons with the pseudoscalar and vector bosonic super-WIMPs in the sub-keV mass region, assuming they are the dominant contributions to the dark matter density of our galaxy.

key_value.quote: using 314.15 kg days of data from $n$-type Point-Contact Germanium detector

name: Constraints on Bosonic Dark Matter with Low Threshold Germanium Detector at Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory

summary.plain: Using 314 kilogram-days of data from a germanium detector, TEXONO looked for very light bosonic dark matter that would be absorbed by the detector and found nothing significant, setting new limits.
summary.technical: 314.15 kg d from an n-type point-contact germanium detector at Kuo-Sheng; super-WIMPs absorbed in the detector give spectral peaks at their mass; no significant excess; limits on the electron couplings of pseudoscalar and vector bosons in the sub-keV mass region.

title: Constraints on Bosonic Dark Matter with Low Threshold Germanium Detector at Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory
why_it_matters: Extends TEXONO's dark matter work from WIMP-nucleon scattering to absorption of light bosons.
